meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会化身 Lead,组建 5 个互相敌对的智能体团队做交叉批评,只保留经受住攻击的洞见,再强制交给 plan 智能体写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp” 等关键词,或需要最高严谨度、暴露薄弱假设与过度设计的规划时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个功能的实现方案
对这份架构方案跑一次 /hyperplan,重点挑过度设计
say.note: 5 个成员互相攻击,只留下站得住的结论

say.text: hyperplan 评审数据库迁移计划,找出没证据的假设
say.note: 最后必须由 plan 智能体输出可执行计划

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member hostile team that cross-critiques each other's findings, keeps only defensible insights, then mandatorily hands them to the `plan` agent to produce an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "hyperplan", "hpp", or "/hyperplan", or when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan how to implement this feature.
say_en.note: Claude first says HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED! then starts the team.

say_en.text: Run /hyperplan on this architecture doc, attacking over-engineering.
say_en.note: The 5 members attack each other; only defensible insights survive.

say_en.text: Hyperplan the database migration plan and find unverified assumptions.
say_en.note: The plan agent then formalizes an executable plan.
